task.title: Creating the QuayIntegration custom resource using the CLI
task.shortdesc: To create the QuayIntegration custom resource from the command line, you can define the configuration in a YAML file and apply it using the oc create command.

ul.li: You have installed the Quay Bridge Operator on OpenShift Container Platform.
You have created a secret containing the OAuth access token in OpenShift Container Platform.
You have installed the OpenShift CLI (oc).

step.cmd: Use the following configuration for a minimal deployment of the QuayIntegration custom resource:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: quay.redhat.com/v1 kind: QuayIntegration metadata: name: example-quayintegration spec: clusterID: openshift credentialsSecret: namespace: openshift-operators name: quay-integration quayHostname: https://<QUAY_URL> insecureRegistry: false

dlentry.dd: Specifies the unique identifier for the OpenShift Container Platform cluster. This value is required and defaults to openshift.
Specifies the namespace and name of the secret containing the token that was previously created.
Specifies the hostname of your Red Hat Quay instance.
Specifies whether Red Hat Quay uses self signed certificates. When Red Hat Quay uses self signed certificates, set the property to insecureRegistry: true.

info.p: For a list of all configuration fields, see "`QuayIntegration` configuration fields".
